scope: Native occurrence-production replay (validateOccurrenceProduction, semanticProgramValidator.ts l.1381) for the brep-1 reachable path plus native $expansion continuation and module-activation anchoring (moduleActivationAnchor l.600, isChildrenExpansionContinuation l.669, and the staticParent runtime ancestor-chain walk in validateOccurrences) behind the WASM ABI; the replay runs against the admitted operations/occurrences/nodes as transported, inside brep_envelope::validate after identity/provenance admission and before Runner::new
coverage: validateOccurrenceProduction ported byte-exactly for the brep-1 reachable path: logical-occurrence grouping (exactly one zero/frame row or dense output rows), canonical-group ordering, parent-before-child runtime group order, per-group compiler-frontier expansion with directChild discipline, $body uniqueness, cross-branch frontier node reuse refusal, and the per-rule production closure for primitive, transform-map, projection-map, offset-map (single-input frontier consumption, JSON.stringify(matrix)/String(cut)/String(distance) field-equal common parameters with the rotate per-space bucket), preserving-alias, transparent, boolean/hull (one-item aliasing, n-ary ordered-frontier reduction, boolean operation name match), difference (compiler $body buckets exactly partitioning the ordered frontier, base/cutter union reducers, difference root shape, bucket-rebuilt schedule), and linear/rotate extrusion (sole profile or one canonical internal union reduction)

Every DAG node must be claimed by exactly one recomputed materializer group; the authenticated group/node schedule replay must equal the node IDs exactly; the synthetic program frontier must equal the transported result row-by-row (producerOccurrence/identityOccurrence/node); every node-bearing occurrence group must be consumed by a root production path

moduleActivationAnchor and isChildrenExpansionContinuation ported exactly: re-parented module-definition occurrences must anchor to their exact matching call body (category/path-segment/discipline, sameDynamicBindings, sole static $body and $expansion, sole runtime children), and every $expansion row must be the exact children() continuation of its matching caller ($index slot equality, lexical containment walk, anchored definition, expanded statements confined to the static subtree), all under the shared 1,000,000-step proof budget; the staticParent runtime ancestor-chain walk (nearest matching ancestor, control/module-only frame crossing) is now native too

same_dynamic_slots now compares identityValueKey(slot.value) exactly as the host does (the previous port keyed on the whole slot object; no admitted program changes, the repeated-ID slotted path now matches TS)

13 new native tests replay seven real lowered fixtures dumped from the TS lowerer and admitted by the host validator (difference, union-with-transform, hull, children/$expansion, module, nested transforms, multi-output union): all admit; wrong-by-one mutations refuse — node with zero materializer groups, node claimed by two groups, broken transform-map chain, bad boolean operand structure (reordered inputs, wrong operation name), hull reduction mismatch, misplaced output ordinal, surgical re-digested $expansion-without-anchor and anchored-row-missing-continuation (identity layer admits, exactly the new rule refuses), structural expansion tampering, result frontier mismatches, and defensive refusal of interrupted terminal/discarded-effects artifacts

TS integration (tests/brepProductionAdmission.test.ts): real lowered difference, union-with-transform and children() programs execute natively end-to-end; a real lowered hull program passes native admission and is refused only downstream by the pre-existing hull evaluation gap (E_BREP_SEMANTIC_UNSUPPORTED); nine production tampers (removed/duplicated occurrence row, broken transform-map chain, reversed boolean/hull inputs, misplaced production node reference, broken $expansion anchor, removed $expansion row, wrong result producer row) refuse with E_BREP_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT and zero onNode progress callbacks
TS adds zero validation logic; the transport is unchanged from the attestation slice
behaviorChange: Graph/session admission now replays occurrence production natively and anchors $expansion/module-activation occurrences before any node executes; requests whose occurrence rows do not close their frozen v1 production rules, whose $expansion rows lack an exact children() continuation anchor, whose node IDs do not equal the authenticated production schedule, or whose result does not equal the synthetic program frontier fail with BREP_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT instead of executing geometry. Requests without transported occurrences behave exactly as before.
limitations: The interrupted-evaluation replay branches (active difference bucket reconstruction, partial maps, completeReduction, terminal prefix equality) remain host-side: they require a non-null execution.terminal or non-empty execution.discardedEffects, which the brep-1 execution-plan admission refuses before the replay runs, so they are unreachable on the native path; the replay also refuses such payloads defensively

The replay runs when the transported occurrences are non-empty and requires the result and execution fields as context (both always present on the executor path); the empty program lowers to zero operations/occurrences/nodes and skips the replay, matching the trivial host pass

The native executor still cannot evaluate hull nodes or curved booleans: a real lowered hull program is admitted by the replay and refused downstream with E_BREP_SEMANTIC_UNSUPPORTED (pre-existing gap, unchanged by this slice)
Occurrence identity admission (including the new anchoring) still requires operations on the request; production replay additionally requires non-empty occurrences plus result/execution
The application executor replacement remains open
